purpose: Least-privilege permission manifest for the staged GitHub-to-NotebookLM digest

endpoint_coverage.GET /installation/repositories: Discover repositories in this App installation; metadata:read is implicit.

excluded_permissions.contents: No write permission; this integration does not modify source repositories.
excluded_permissions.pull_requests: No write permission; this integration does not create or review PRs.
excluded_permissions.discussions: Not requested; no discussion data is collected.
excluded_permissions.administration: Not requested; no repository settings are changed.
